Looking at the diff, the controller at app/controllers/embed_controller.rb line 12 sets `@topic_view = TopicView.new(topic_id, current_user, {best: 5})`, and the template at app/views/embed/best.html.erb accesses `@topic_view.posts` and `@topic_view.topic`. The test mocks TopicView.new but doesn't provide a return value, meaning @topic_view would be nil or a mock without the required interface. This is a legitimate test coverage concern - the test verifies the controller calls TopicView.new but doesn't verify the template can actually render with the result. However, this is a test quality issue rather than a bug in production code.
